title: 799. Minimum Swaps To Make Sequences Increasing

examples.explanation: One swap at the end fixes both arrays.
Swapping index 1 makes both strictly increasing.

hints: Track two costs at each index: cheapest cost with no swap here versus with a swap here.
From the previous pair, transition only when the order constraints allow keeping or crossing the two arrangements.
Take the minimum of the two states at the final index.
